Q00456_DontKnowDontCare/32864-02.html.text: Separated Soul: Thanks. (This quest can be completed once a day. This quest resets everyday at 6:30 am.)

Q00456_DontKnowDontCare/32864-01.htm.text: Separated Soul: Anyhow, do you know me? Do you know my name? No... you probably dont... That's what everyone says... You're no different.

Q00456_DontKnowDontCare/32864-03.html.text: Separated Soul: I suppose you wish to be a ripped soul like me, hmm? (Must be above level 80 to do this quest)

Q00456_DontKnowDontCare/32864-09.html.text: Separated Soul: Have you gathered all three essences... No... No... Remember, I need the Essence of Drake Lord ... the Behemoth Leader's Essence ... and... the Dragon Beast's Essence ...

Q00456_DontKnowDontCare/32864-05.htm.text: Separated Soul: No, it's the opposite. Many adventurers told me names coming from Antharas' Lair . Names like Drake Lord, Behemoth Leader, Dragon Beast . I just wanted to know my name, but I ended up learning about names of other monsters.
